annotations.title: Department of corrections internal policies (NOT law)

description: Internal policies of a state department of corrections, or of the Federal Bureau of Prisons (state="bop", federal), as the department posts them, by number or by keyword search (query; no stemming). Not law: not statutes, regulations or court rules (a Maine policy the department marks as adopted as a rule answers apa_marked true; Kentucky’s policies are adopted by reference in its regulations, 501 KAR 6, in a dated edition the served copy may not match). A department can change its policies without notice, and policies it does not post are not here. An answer gives the number, title, the dates the file prints, the version replaced where the file names one, the date GLO read the file, and the department’s coverage_note; a revoked policy is listed with the successor its notice names; a number the department lists but does not post answers not posted; a held number answers its status and reason, never text. Departments loaded: one code each in the state enum, among them "ks-go" (Kansas facility General Orders); many are partial, with served and held counts per department. "hi" (Hawaii) serves text for only 40 of 204 posted files, machine-read with no human read; every other row of its list answers its reason, never text. A state absent from the enum is not loaded, which says nothing about whether its department has such a policy. The sources tool returns, per state code, the department’s source, read date, served and held counts, held reasons and number forms. Give number or query, not both. topic="grievance", "visitation", "mail" (mail and publications), "restrictive-housing" or "use-of-force" (use of force and restraints), alone or with one state, answers a cross-state topic view: per department, the policies GLO found by title on the topic and their GLO status when the view was built; recall is not measured, and no match found is not evidence of none.

limit.description: max search results, default 20, capped at 50 (search only)

number.description: a procedure, section, directive or policy number as the department prints it, e.g. "851.1", "OP 038.1", "01-103D" (Kansas), "TCF 15-101" (a Kansas facility General Order); number "contents" lists a department’s files where its coverage says so; the forms per department are given by sources(tool="corrections_policy", source=<code>)

query.description: words to match in the policies’ text (keyword, no stemming). Give number or query, not both

state.description: the department: a state code (e.g. "va", "ks", "ks-go" for Kansas facility General Orders) or "bop" (the Federal Bureau of Prisons); each code’s department and coverage are given by sources(tool="corrections_policy", source=<code>); required unless topic is given

topic.description: a cross-state topic view, "grievance", "visitation", "mail", "restrictive-housing" or "use-of-force": alone, every department’s row in one answer; with state, that department’s row; never with number or query
